name: Bring the Light
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Scourge is a persistent threat to the Alliance, a fact I am sure you know quite well. Recently, we have come across some very peculiar findings, adventurer.

In the Barrens lies a horrid tangle of briars called Razorfen Downs. While once it was the home of simple quilboar, now it has become apparent that a pact was made with the Scourge, creating creatures far worse... They are now ruled by the lich, Amnennar the Coldbringer.

Align yourself with the Light, adventurer; put an end to this evil union.
narrative.objectives: Archbishop Bendictus wants you to slay Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you , adventurer. The Scourge will now think twice before attempting to bolster its ranks again.

May you be blessed by the Light.
narrative.requestItemsText: Amnennar must be eradicated. Go, swiftly.
